mapper.insert: WITH stopped AS(UPDATE pf.file_transfer_slot SET owner_id=NULL,object_key_hash=NULL,process_role=NULL,process_id=NULL,started_at=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND owner_id=#{owner} RETURNING id) INSERT INTO pf.file_transfer_release(owner_id) SELECT #{owner} FROM stopped
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_transfer_release WHERE owner_id=#{owner})
